description: Navigate the subject tree. Pass a node id path under /table/ (default empty = root list of subjects). Each level returns child nodes ({id, type, text}); type "l" is a folder, "t" is a leaf table whose id is the numeric table id used by table_meta/query_table. e.g. path "" -> subjects, "be" -> Population, "be05" -> Population count tables.

path.description: Sub-path under /table/ (default empty = root). e.g. "be" or "be05".

name: subjects
title: Subjects
